##### Project general facts

Al Hamra Waterfront is a collection of waterfront residences set directly on the sea, with direct beach access and open views across the water. The community is spread across four clusters, with five apartment buildings rising above a ground floor and a podium distributed among three clusters, and a fourth cluster dedicated to duplex townhouses. The project offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside luxury townhouses, each residence with a private balcony and open waterfront views.

Residents enjoy private beach access and an exclusive yacht marina, complemented by a waterfront promenade lined with gourmet dining and cafes. A panoramic fitness centre, an outdoor fitness area and several swimming pools with sea views support an active lifestyle, while a signature spa and wellness centre offers calm and renewal. Executive co-working spaces, a screening lounge, a marina club house, luxury retail boutiques, a padel tennis court, a barbecue area, a kids' play area and a pet grooming area with a pet park complete the offer.

The design draws on the five elements of nature, with warm, earthy tones that echo the coastal landscape and a sense of stability and growth. Residences feature modern interiors, generous ceiling heights and roomy layouts filled with natural light. Private balconies open towards the sea, the marina and the surrounding greenery. Kitchens are fitted with appliances, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamra Village is a fully integrated coastal master community in Ras Al Khaimah, combining pristine beaches, interconnected lagoons and lush landscaping. The Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, Al Hamra Marina, a championship golf course and Al Hamra Mall sit at the heart of the community, together with five-star resorts such as Waldorf Astoria and The Ritz-Carlton Al Hamra Beach.

Al Marjan Island and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort are a short drive or a brief boat ride away. Medical centres, sports facilities and an international school are close by, while Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects the community with Dubai, Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport, keeping the wider region within comfortable driving distance.

Al Hamra Village is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most established communities in Ras Al Khaimah. Beachfront homes with private beach access are in limited supply, and the rapid growth of tourism around Al Marjan Island supports strong demand for both holiday and long-term rentals. A mature lifestyle offer and accessible entry points compared with Dubai underpin long-term value.
